notes: Controller tuned for moderate speed and stable PID gains to leverage improved sensor layout and size, expecting better line detection and fewer line loss events.
rationale: The geometry has 5 sensors arranged symmetrically and slightly forward, which should improve early line detection and reduce line loss events. The sensor size is medium (0.012), balancing resolution and noise robustness. The body size and wheel track are moderate, providing stability and maneuverability. To integrate this geometry, I designed a PID controller with moderate gains to handle the expected improved sensor input quality. The base speed is set moderately to balance speed and control. Sensor weights are assigned symmetrically, with higher weights to the central sensors to prioritize line center detection. The line loss behavior is set to 'search_left' to recover from line loss effectively. The observation request includes the upstream requested measurements to verify the hypotheses about improved line following and reduced line loss events.
